items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I can relate to somebody that's low-keyed... I'm very comfortable with sitting next to Mackel... Oh, he took care of me. He had me in shape in a week's time

ctx.x: Yeah, this was after this. Because Wes worked with Hamp...Wes's was a short period because he took the guitar player's place. See, William Mackel was the guitar player with Hamp, and had been for over the years, up until here recently when he left. And when Mackel got ill at one point, Wes took his place while he was off. Wes worked with him. When he came back, then that was the end of the thing for Hamp for Wes. But that wasn't what Wes wanted to make his career doing. But, boy, he made a hot set there, when he…

And I do believe, on the strength of the thing with Wes was how I got the job with Hamp. Because when they came to town, Lionel Hampton came to town about '49 or '50. 1949, 1950, in there. When they came to town, Wes was working with the band and...Boy, that was a...Lionel Hampton, he was big!
